name: Zed
source: A miniature seal that Lamune caught by chance while fishing. Takes an instant liking to Lamune and Lamune decides to keep it. At first they thought Zed would eat Sora-chan, so they tried to keep them apart, but after some time they discover Zed and Sora-chan became good friends somewhere they didn't know.
